posts.name: Alan E
posts.cooked:
Hey my friends,

We are alerting about this Fake NEAR Wallet that is available in Play Store.

image1470×1344 78.5 KB

At NEAR Hispano, our community member Alexander (Platohedro | @platobos ) had lost all his funds for using this wallet. Please be alert about this.

TRANSACTION AND MORE INFO

This fake wallet request for pass phrase and after transfer funds to an account called bigbank101.near, also I can see that this app uses stolen accounts to found in staking pools for tokens.

Transaction where tokens are stolen:

explorer.near.org

Explorer Selector

Explore the NEAR Blockchain for transactions, addresses, tokens, prices and other information.

Amount of NEAR tokens stolen: 121 NEAR

Account bigbank101.near : Explorer Selector

@amgando @claudioac @Cristian @David_NEAR
